definitions.gloss: wicked or impure thoughts; distracting thoughts
definitions.explanation: Thoughts that are morally wrong, such as ill will or greed, or more loosely any stray thoughts that get in the way of concentration. Common in Buddhist and martial-arts talk of clearing the mind.

examples.japanese: {邪念|じゃねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
{邪念|じゃねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}する→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧。
examples.english: To clear one's mind of stray thoughts and concentrate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{座禅|ざぜん}→座禅：09641_zazen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んで→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{邪念|じゃねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}え→消える：02520_kieru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: Even sitting in zazen, I couldn't get rid of my stray thoughts.
